title: CIA-UAP-D022, Unidentified Flying Object Reported near Puerto Rico, 1965
doc_notes: This is a CIA memorandum regarding the investigation of a high-speed, high-altitude UFO sighting near Puerto Rico in November 1964, which includes radar analysis.

encounters.summary: A US Navy pilot observed a high-speed object near the USS Gyatt off the coast of Puerto Rico, which was also tracked on radar.
encounters.quote: US Navy F-4C pilot was able to distinguish the object as a delta shape about the size of a jet fighter
